item.title: CVE-2026-136231 — Local file disclosure through dragged external attachments
item.description: A received message could include an attachment that referred to an arbitrary local file under a misleading name. If the user dragged that attachment into a message being composed and sent it, the contents of the referenced local file were included in…

item.title: CVE-2026-136230 — CardDAV server credentials could be sent to an HTTP proxy
item.description: When a CardDAV address book was accessed through an HTTP proxy that requested authentication, Thunderbird could answer the proxy with the CardDAV server's username and password. This affected both setting up a new address book and syncing existing on…

item.title: CVE-2026-136229 — Signature date check bypassed with a missing, invalid or repeated Date header
item.description: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be us…

item.title: CVE-2026-136228 — Signature date check not applied to encrypted OpenPGP messages
item.description: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current da…

item.title: CVE-2026-136227 — IMAP command injection and JavaScript execution when opening a crafted email
